Visitor PUT /api/c/campaigns/{BID} returns 403. My decisions renders 9 prompts with greyed example lines; decisions-edit → decision-answer-0='TEST answer' + verdict-revise + verdict-reason → decisions-save → reload persists; booth-next shows 'REVISE'. All test edits reverted (budget low/high/note cleared, all 9 decision answers cleared, verdict + verdict_reason cleared) via PUT /api/c/campaigns/{BID} and confirmed via GET. Home ?as=owner: home-booth-link href='/campaigns?booth=1' and navigates correctly, booth auto-selects; home-entry-03 href='/score'. Visitor (?as=visitor): booth-story visible, budget-edit and decisions-edit hidden (query returns null); 14 campaign-* textareas are all read-only (0 editable). Mobile 390x844: 8 chapters render, booth-nav scrolls horizontally, journey-tab-D switches stage and shows polaroid, overall layout stacks correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Measure.jsx uses document.querySelector(location.hash) directly to resolve a scroll target. If a user ever navigates to /strategy/measure#booth?as=owner (wrong URL ordering), the hash becomes '#booth?as=owner' and querySelector throws 'is not a valid selector' — I hit this once by typo. Not a real-world path (links to /strategy/measure#booth are correctly ordered elsewhere), but a two-line guard (try/catch or strip non-id chars) would prevent an Emergent runtime-error overlay from showing.

BoothStory Decisions component has no UI control to clear the verdict once set — the three verdict-{proceed|revise|stop} buttons only set the value, they don't toggle. The spec asked to 'revert verdict via edit + save', which is only achievable by API. Low priority: either add a 'Clear verdict' button or make clicking the active verdict toggle it off.
strategy.py ensure_v3 correctly checks meta.booth_seeded and campaigns.find_one by name to avoid duplicates; the campaigns list stays at exactly 2 across repeated server restarts.
booth-nav is 8 chapters but spec text said 'each booth-nav-* link scrolls to booth-chapter-*' — chapter count matches 8 anchors, verified.
No em dash characters in booth story — consistent with the house style rule for this portfolio.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (owner edit/save/revert, visitor read-only, home link, measure link, mobile all pass)

seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data created. Temporary writes (budget low_0='£1,000 (test)', decision-answer-0='TEST answer', verdict='revise', verdict_reason='TEST reason') were all reverted via PUT /api/c/campaigns/{BID} to empty strings. Verified via GET that story.verdict='', story.decisions[0].a='', story.budget[0].low=''.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Booth campaign is complete and the DB is in the original seeded state. Reusable regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_booth_iter10.py (6 tests). Minor note for UI tests: BoothStory does not expose a UI 'clear verdict' control, so if a future test needs to revert verdict to empty, do it via PUT /api/c/campaigns/{id}. The measure page scrolls to '#booth' only if the hash is exactly '#booth' — do not append query params after the hash.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs blocking the spec. Only one defensive-coding comment (Measure.jsx querySelector on raw hash).
